
scripts adapted from EmmaGravesen [squirrel_functional_diversity](https://github.com/alberdilab/squirrels_functional_diversity/tree/main)

### functional differences


```{r}
# Aggregate bundle-level GIFTs into the compound level
GIFTs_elements <- to.elements(genome_gifts, GIFT_db2)

GIFTs_elements_filtered <- GIFTs_elements[rownames(GIFTs_elements) %in% genome_counts$genome, ]
GIFTs_elements_filtered <- as.data.frame(GIFTs_elements_filtered) %>%
  select_if(~ !is.numeric(.) || sum(.) != 0)

elements <- GIFTs_elements_filtered %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Aggregate element-level GIFTs into the function level
GIFTs_functions <- to.functions(GIFTs_elements_filtered, GIFT_db2)
functions <- GIFTs_functions %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Aggregate function-level GIFTs into overall Biosynthesis, Degradation and Structural GIFTs
GIFTs_domains <- to.domains(GIFTs_functions, GIFT_db2)
domains <- GIFTs_domains %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Get community-weighed average GIFTs per sample
GIFTs_elements_community <- to.community(GIFTs_elements_filtered, tss(genome_counts_filt[-1]), GIFT_db2)
GIFTs_functions_community <- to.community(GIFTs_functions,tss(genome_counts_filt[-1]), GIFT_db2)
GIFTs_domains_community <- to.community(GIFTs_domains,tss(genome_counts_filt[-1]), GIFT_db2)
```


```{r}
GIFTs_functions_community %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column(var="sample") %>%
    pivot_longer(!sample,names_to="trait",values_to="gift") %>%
    left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == sample)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=trait,y=sample,fill=gift)) +
        geom_tile(colour="white", linewidth=0.2)+
        scale_fill_gradientn(colours=rev(c("#d53e4f", "#f46d43", "#fdae61", "#fee08b", "#e6f598", "#abdda4", "#ddf1da")))+
        facet_grid(habitat ~ ., scales="free",space="free") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())

ggsave(paste0('figure/habitat_gift_function.png'), width=15, height=10, units='cm')
```

```{r}
# Merge all metrics
alpha <- list(richness,neutral,phylogenetic) %>%
  reduce(full_join,by="sample") %>%
  as.data.frame()
```


```{r}
GIFTs_domains_diversity <- GIFTs_domains_community %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  add_rownames(var = "sample") %>%
  left_join(alpha, by="sample") %>% 
  left_join(sample_metadata, by="sample")%>% 
select(-ends_with(".x"))

wilcox_domain = list()
for (col in seq_along(colnames(domains))) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste(colnames(domains)[col], "~ habitat"))
  test_result <- wilcox.test(formula, 
                             data = GIFTs_domains_diversity)
  wilcox_domain[[col]] <- test_result
}
wilcox_domain

for (col in colnames(domains)) {
  cat("\nPairwise Wilcoxon tests for:", col, "\n")
  print(pairwise.wilcox.test(GIFTs_domains_diversity[[col]], 
                             GIFTs_domains_diversity$event_id, 
                             p.adjust.method = "bonferroni"))
}

```


```{r}
GIFTs_functions_diversity <- GIFTs_functions_community %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  add_rownames(var = "sample") %>%
  left_join(alpha, by="sample") %>% 
  left_join(sample_metadata, by="sample")%>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
select(-ends_with(".x"))

wilcox_function = list()
for (col in seq_along(colnames(functions))) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste(colnames(functions)[col], "~ habitat"))
  test_result <- wilcox.test(formula, 
                             data = GIFTs_functions_diversity)
  wilcox_function[[col]] <- test_result
}
wilcox_function

for (col in colnames(functions)) {
  cat("\nPairwise Wilcoxon tests for:", col, "\n")
  print(pairwise.wilcox.test(GIFTs_functions_diversity[[col]], 
                             GIFTs_functions_diversity$event_id, 
                             p.adjust.method = "bonferroni"))
}
```
